prompts.compounds: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent sprite atlas containing SIX independent hand-drawn neighborhood vignettes for a Beijing Fengtai memory map. The two input images are STYLE REFERENCES only: preserve their very simple broad marks and colors, not detailed architecture. Layout: exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, each motif centered inside its own equal cell, generous completely transparent gutters and margins (at least 12% of each cell); nothing crosses a cell edge. No grid lines or text. Viewed from a consistent slightly elevated three-quarter isometric angle, roofs visible. All six have roughly equal modest visual weight. Top row: (1) three cream apartment towers with muted blue balcony bands and red roof caps, sparse small green dabs; (2) three long parallel cream six-story slab blocks with muted coral horizontal stripes and gray flat roofs; (3) two simple L-shaped cream/coral slab blocks around a small open inner yard. Bottom row: (4) two blue-banded towers behind two low slab blocks, (5) four long gray-beige Soviet-style walk-up slabs in parallel rows, (6) three cream slabs with one detached single-story shop strip set apart from the housing. Detached shops must not become first-floor shops in the residential building. No roads, sidewalks, street labels, people, cars, traditional hutong courtyards, European houses, extra city backdrop, or rectangular tile ground. Each is an isolated compound motif, with at most a pale irregular green wash under the buildings and two or three leafy brush dabs. Style: casual travel-journal pen and soft colored pencil on paper, warm and relaxed, thick uneven sketch edges and coarse broad color strokes. These will be shown only 180–260 pixels wide: skip individual window frames, repetitive fine lines, balconies, detailed railings. Windows are a few grouped bands or tiny sparse dabs. Transparent background including between the six vignettes; paper grain only within the painted marks. This is a type study, not an exact map.
prompts.buildings: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent reusable sprite sheet with NINE separate building cutouts, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, equal cells, generous transparent gutters and margins, all fully contained. The two input images are STYLE REFERENCES: match their bold simple colored-pencil and wobbly pen forms at SMALL map scale. Same elevated three-quarter isometric angle for every cutout. Row one: three variants of the SAME compact square tower mass, cream with blue horizontal bands/red roof cap; cream with warm gray bands/coral cap; pale warm gray with dusty sage bands. Only four or five broad marks for facade bands, not every story. Row two: long narrow Soviet-era six-story slab in cream/coral; the same slab in pale peach/gray; one L-shaped slab with cream walls and coral bands. Row three: single detached one-story shop with flat gray roof and muted green blank fascia; same shop with faded red blank fascia; two attached low shops as one short module with blue-gray blank fascia. No words or signs, no text, no numbers, no people, no cars, no roads, no sidewalks, no surrounding blocks, no rectangular paper patches. Simple iconic volumes, very few window/door marks. Warm informal travel notebook doodles, substantial irregular hand-drawn strokes and paper tooth inside the color, not CAD, not polished architectural student drawings. Final intended width per building only 90–180 pixels, so keep strokes and shadows broad. All background and gutters truly transparent.
